dataLoss.note: Lost actions belong to the original lineage; the restored pickup belongs to a new branch. Restoring the checkpoint does not compensate deliveries, merge later history or prevent reuse of acknowledged sequence numbers.

recovery.limitations: Owned local deterministic trial only. Restoring an older snapshot discards later state and actions, and reopens acknowledged sequence numbers. No recovery epoch or retained sequence floor is implemented. This is not a transactionally safe production rollback or a deployment.
